label: PROSPECTIVE STUDY under docs/consolidated_recall_protocol.md (Step C). O and I are evaluator-only references; CR-oracle-mode and CR-oracle-law are PRIVILEGED arms (lagged true index). DEVELOPMENT PHASE (seeds 20101-20103); results may change only d and tau.

calibration.statistic: l_theta - l_EMA(d) from the EMA-global development fit with the same d

development.note: the development phase produces d and tau; nothing is given

oracle.kind: O only (true-law column of the 512-sample MC with common random numbers); I is NOT computed for development seeds, so recovery is reported relative to O

tau.method: numpy.percentile, linear interpolation, pooled over the development seeds

selection.rule: lowest mean development stream excess over O (cycles 3-8); if several d are within one paired seed-SE of the best (SE of the per-seed difference to the best d, ddof=1, /sqrt(3)), take the largest of them

pathology.reading: fires if ANY development seed shows any condition (the literal, conservative reading); the seed-mean reading is reported alongside
pathology.implication: CR is NOT taken to test; revise the protocol and use a new, disjoint development cohort

C1.method: normal model of the per-seed ratio (mean, SD with ddof=1 from the development seeds); P(a seed improves) = Phi((1-mean)/SD); P(>=10/12) is the binomial tail; the threshold part uses the mean of 12 ratios ~ N(mean, SD/sqrt(12)). Informal, not a gate.

C2.method: normal model of the per-seed ratio (mean, SD with ddof=1 from the development seeds); P(a seed improves) = Phi((1-mean)/SD); P(>=10/12) is the binomial tail; the threshold part uses the mean of 12 ratios ~ N(mean, SD/sqrt(12)). Informal, not a gate.

C3_proxy_vs_O.method: normal model of the per-seed ratio (mean, SD with ddof=1 from the development seeds); P(a seed improves) = Phi((1-mean)/SD); P(>=10/12) is the binomial tail; the threshold part uses the mean of 12 ratios ~ N(mean, SD/sqrt(12)). Informal, not a gate.

power.note: C3 is defined relative to I, which is not computed for development seeds; the C3 row uses recovery excess over O as a proxy and is descriptive only
